subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A reservoir installed floating solar panels.”?
options: The project showed how data can create care.
The floating panels showed creative use of space, but also required care.
The roadside inn showed that movement has always required places of pause.
A news report showed a floating farm built on water.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The project showed how data can create care.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The floating panels showed creative use of space, but also required care.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The roadside inn showed that movement has always required places of pause.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A news report showed a floating farm built on water.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The floating panels showed creative use of space, but also required care.」，答案為「The floating panels showed creative use of space, but also required care.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The floating panels showed creative use of space, but also required care.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
